training: R35G four evaluation and four shared groups, already used by R40C; frozen R40C inference for generating features. Fit only R40C alert rows with localized-positive labels vs control or mislocalized alerts. Separate two R35G calibration groups; no R40C transfer rows used to fit or tune.
features: Two candidate paths, R40C and R28 score (signed log transform), path agreement, robust local trace, background profile, temporal consistency, isolated extreme pixels, path roughness; winsorize each feature at historical training quantiles 1 and 99%, standardize.
screen: A logistic score applied to already alerted R40C candidates; cutoff equals minimum among ALL localized calibration positives (no calibration localized loss), or no-op if no positive alerts. Protected arm additionally retains any R40C alert with R28 alert and same-path agreement on >=12 rows within 2 channels. No threshold tuned on new transfer data. Keep every unscreened alert and path in artifacts; screen is a review priority not destructive deletion.
gate: Fewer control alerts than R40C, zero lost R40C localized positives including weak and shared-reference positives on transfer, preserve R40C weak gain vs R28; report per-group and added/lost. No selection on viewed transfer. If loss >0 HOLD even with improved aggregate. No independent claim.
scope: Development replay of previously observed transfer dataset. Neither R38 nor campaign-wide false alarm proof. Future blind data required.
